v.title: Mbappé’s El Clasico Spark Leaves Barça on Edge
v.excerpt: Mbappé’s two goals give Madrid a 2‑1 win over Barça in El Clasico, exposing Barcelona’s defensive woes and raising questions about their title push.
v.body:
## Quick take
Mbappé lit up the Camp Nou, netting twice as Real Madrid edged Barcelona 2‑1 in a bruising El Clasico. The French forward’s pace and precision left the Catalan defence scrambling.

## What happened
The match started with Barcelona’s high‑press, but Real’s counter‑attack rhythm proved lethal. In the 23rd minute, Mbappé slipped past two defenders and curled a left‑foot strike past Marc‑Polo, giving Madrid an early lead.

Barcelona responded with a swift counter. Pedri’s through ball to Raphinha found the edge of the box, but the shot was saved by Thibaut Courtois. A few minutes later, Mbappé doubled the advantage with a deft finish from the edge of the area, sealing a 2‑0 advantage that would prove decisive.

## Why it matters
- **Mbappé’s goal‑scoring form**: With two goals in a single El Clasico, Mbappé reaffirms his status as a decisive player in high‑pressure matches, boosting his confidence ahead of the Champions League knockout stages.
- **Barcelona’s defensive frailties**: The backline’s inability to contain a single opponent at pace highlights a persistent issue that could cost Barça in crucial fixtures, especially against teams that exploit quick transitions.
- **Seasonal implications**: The loss drops Barça further behind Real in La Liga and raises questions about their tactical setup under Xavi, as they seek to salvage a title‑challenging season.

## What's next
Barça’s next outing will be the Copa del Rey semi‑final against a top‑flight opponent. Fans should focus on how the team adapts after a defensive collapse—will they tighten the back four or rely on a more aggressive pressing scheme? Meanwhile, Mbappé’s form will be a key variable for Real as they prepare to face a determined Barca side that is desperate to overturn this deficit. Watching the tactical adjustments in the next match will reveal whether Barcelona can recover from this setback and regain momentum in both domestic and European competitions.
